page.overview:
Who is Oswald's Father?

Oswald's unnamed father is a major character in Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit, appearing in the first story of the same name, as well as its adaptations: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit and Return to the Pit. He's a somewhat older man who wants to give his son the best, even with his poor income. His capture and replacement by the Yellow Rabbit causes Oswald to step up, sneak out of the house, and find him within the mysterious ballpit.

The book describes Oswald’s father as having stubble. He isn’t a big man, but he still weighs twice as much as Oswald. He wears a red vest to work, white undershirts, and steel-toed brown work boots with thick boot socks. The story's illustration depicts Oswald's father as slightly pot-bellied with slicked back gray hair, a mustache, and a beard. He also has bushy black eyebrows. He wears a pair of blue jeans and white shirt.

In the game adaptation, Oswald's father is plus-sized with brown hair and a beard, a blue t-shirt, blue jeans, and black shoes. When replaced by the Yellow Rabbit, it takes his form except with glowing bright blue eyes.

His age is never specified, but he was around Oswald's age in 1985, which means he was born in the early 1970s. His story takes place over the late 2010s-early 2020s, so he is roughly in his 40s.
